963	and to pour out his speech before HaShem,

964	and to ask of Him with mercy and supplication to merit

965	to draw close to His service. Set aside time every day to talk to

966	our Father in Heaven. See what an easy piece of advice we said: don't be clever, don't be sharp, you don't need to be

968	to deliver some moving speech with

970	Something simple, simple, from the heart, sincere, even dry,

971	without feelings, without anything. Say it, speak.

972	And after he said all this, he says:

973	everything I am commanded to do

975	You tell me I have an easy fix for you, the easiest

976	in the world, no tzaddik gave such an easy fix to people

977	like these, HaShem have mercy, who went through what they went through.

978	Why, why do you tell me it is so hard?

979	Because of this, it is hard, because it weighs so much.

980	That is why it is hard. It is not really hard, it is hard

981	because there are forces that clothe themselves in it: do everything, just not this. Do whatever you want, be great

982	in Torah, be a giver of charity, be wise, be

983	rich, be successful, raise children, do whatever

984	you want, just don't speak with the Holy One, blessed be He.
